fact: The government launched a national portal at www.service-public.gov.bf on 5 May 2026 in Ouagadougou to centralize online public services, per We Are Tech Africa.
The portal provides 95 dematerialized procedures and 1,672 information sheets, and integrates 183 public institutions, per We Are Tech Africa.

The government announced on 20 February 2026 the official launch of version 2 of the Service Public BF portal, with search covering e-services, step-by-step life-event guides and an administration directory.

The Minister of Economy and Finance launched SECOP on 23 June 2025, a portal through which firms request and receive administrative certificates (tax, CNSS, trade-register, non-bankruptcy and others) remotely.

Ecofin reports Burkina Faso launched three justice platforms in mid-December 2025 to file and track complaints online, request prison visit permits and apply for commercial registry documents, and had earlier moved nationality certificate and criminal record applications online.

The government information service reports that the digital transition minister launched the ATI platform on 2 April 2024, where firms apply online for the IT technical accreditation, track the request and verify an issued accreditation.
